violations.text: No person certified in food safety were present as needed at the time of inspection. PIC is currently enrolled in food safety learning courses and is scheduled to take test next month. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager with RIDOH CFP certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026

The following floors underneath and behind equipment in the mop sink area and kitchen area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/22/2026
